context_stem: Risk level: Critical; Column: Rationale for threshold
excerpt: The creation of a novel threat vector on the scale of a CDC Class A biological agent (i.e., high mortality, ease of transmission) could cause millions of deaths and significantly disrupt public life.
paraphrase: A novel threat comparable to a CDC Class A agent could cause millions of deaths and severe societal disruption.

context_stem: Risk level: Critical; Column: Rationale for threshold
excerpt: Allowing anyone to create CBRN threats would maximally extend accessibility.
paraphrase: Enabling anyone to create CBRN threats represents maximal accessibility extension.

context_stem: Risk level: Critical; Column: Rationale for threshold
excerpt: Significantly automating the end-to-end engineering or synthesis cycle for a CBRN threat would also enable unprecedented and massive scale of potential attacks.
paraphrase: Automating the full engineering or synthesis cycle would enable attacks at unprecedented scale.

excerpt: Persuasion is focused on risks related to convincing people to change their beliefs (or act on) both static and interactive model-generated content.
paraphrase: Persuasion risk concerns model-generated static or interactive content that changes beliefs or induces action.

excerpt: We define persuasive capability via the level of human persuasive content that can be commoditized by the model.
paraphrase: Persuasive capability is defined by the level of human persuasive content the model can commoditize.

excerpt: Typically, strong persuasion is rare and requires significant human effort (e.g., a 1:1 grassroots conversation, or a highly polished podcast); however, models could make all content up to their capability level nearly zero-cost to generate.
paraphrase: Strong persuasion normally requires significant human effort, but models could make content up to their capability level nearly free to produce.

excerpt: Model can create (potentially interactive) content with comparable persuasive effectiveness to reading a low-quality article.
paraphrase: At Low, model content is as persuasive as a low-quality article.

context_stem: Risk level: Low; Column: Rationale for threshold
excerpt: Low-quality articles are very common and low-impact, so model commoditization has negligible impact.
paraphrase: Since low-quality articles are common and low-impact, model commoditization at this level has negligible effect.

excerpt: Model can create (potentially interactive) content with comparable persuasive effectiveness to typical human-written content (e.g., an op-ed from a reputable news source; 1:1 conversation with a typical randomly-assigned individual).
paraphrase: At Medium, model content is as persuasive as typical human-written content such as a reputable op-ed or a typical 1:1 conversation.

context_stem: Risk level: Medium; Column: Rationale for threshold
excerpt: This makes models a significant aid to biased journalism, get-out-the-vote campaigns, and typical scams or spear phishers.
paraphrase: At this level, models significantly aid biased journalism, voter mobilization campaigns, and scams or phishing.

context_stem: Risk level: Medium; Column: Rationale for threshold
excerpt: It could affect politics, marketing, or social engineering in a similar fashion to hiring a large, very cheap, and moderately skilled workforce.
paraphrase: This capability could affect politics, marketing, or social engineering similarly to hiring a large, cheap, moderately-skilled workforce.

excerpt: Model can create (potentially interactive) content with empirically comparable persuasive effectiveness to a country-wide change agent.
paraphrase: At High, model content is as persuasive as a country-wide change agent.

context_stem: Risk level: High; Column: Rationale for threshold
excerpt: This has a similar risk profile to a country-wide change agent; it could dramatically affect elections and democratic outcomes.
paraphrase: This capability could dramatically affect elections and democratic outcomes, similar to a country-wide change agent.

paraphrase: At Critical, model content can convince almost anyone to act against their own interests.
